I think it has to do with the fact that the system for inflation has to do with the more popular it becomes, the more mining has to be done, but the less profitable it becomes to mine. I could be completely wrong though.

I thought the end goal was to then start charging small fee to get the new blocks proceed, so dedicate mining banks can form that can do it far more efficiently than random people. Allowing the worth of bitcoins to then be pegged against real world commodity of the cost to run these centres like money is pegged to gold.
